campaigns_running_is_executable.name: campaigns_running_is_executable
campaigns_running_is_executable.value: "campaigns"."status" <> 'running' OR ("campaigns"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "campaigns"."playbook_id" IS NOT NULL)

leads_contactable.name: leads_contactable
leads_contactable.value:
"leads"."linkedin_url" IS NOT NULL OR "leads"."email" IS NOT NULL
          OR "leads"."instagram_username" IS NOT NULL OR "leads"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL

prospects_contactable.name: prospects_contactable
prospects_contactable.value:
"prospects"."linkedin_url" IS NOT NULL OR "prospects"."instagram_username" IS NOT NULL
          OR "prospects"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "prospects"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL
